newsitem.title: UK: Telewest to develop fibre optic network - FT.
newsitem.headline: Telewest to develop fibre optic network - FT.

text.p: Britain's Telewest Communications Plc will invest 50 million pounds ($82.85 million) in a venture to develop a national fibre optic network with Racal Electronics Plc, the Financial Times reported on Thursday.

The paper said the network would link Telewest's cable franchises in Britain and significantly increase the cable television and phone operator's ability to bypass British Telecommunications Plc's system. Other long-distance carriers were also involved in the deal, the paper said.

Telewest chief executive Stephen Davidson was quoted as saying the company was still in talks about digital television with British Sky Broadcasting Group Plc, with a view to introducing the new service in the fourth quarter.
BSkyB is partly-owned by News Corp Ltd.
